project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual to short-lived perennial with striking red to maroon ray bases and yellow tips; hairy stems/leaves; phyllaries often reflexed or spreading.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, mostly entire to lobed, hairy; lower leaves often spoon-shaped or lobed.
morphology_keys.heads: Large showy heads with red/maroon-centered rays tipped yellow; disk reddish to purplish.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: In several series, often spreading or reflexed, sometimes somewhat leafy.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with a pappus of scales/aristate awns.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
